description: Session utility request and response models.

models.name: SetHeartbeatNatTimeoutRequest
models.description: Runtime NAT timeout hint for adaptive heartbeat scheduling. Omit or pass null to clear the hint.

fields.name: natTimeoutSecs
fields.description: Observed NAT idle timeout in seconds.

models.name: HeartbeatEffectiveIntervalResponse
models.description: Currently effective heartbeat interval for diagnostics and platform observability.

fields.name: connected
fields.description: Whether a live transport is available.

fields.name: intervalMs
fields.description: Effective heartbeat interval in milliseconds when connected.

fields.name: intervalSecs
fields.description: Effective heartbeat interval in seconds when connected.

models.name: SetConnectTokenRefresherRequest
models.description: Installs or removes the host's connect token refresher at the native boundary. Platform packages build it from their one host function; hosts do not send it themselves.

models.name: CompleteConnectTokenRefreshRequest
models.description: Answer to one connect token refresh request.

fields.name: requestId
fields.description: Request id the core asked with.

fields.name: token
fields.description: The new connect token; omitted or empty when none could be obtained.
